title: 現在：分清投資者，回到那頁帳本

data.prompt: Medium shot in a records office in November 2019, one generic clerk removes a plain company folder from a public-listing shelf, concentrated expression, an archive tray centered below the folder, soft grey daylight

lines.text: 二〇一九年十一月四日，梅林娛樂的私有化交易生效，股票從倫敦證券交易所下市。

data.prompt: Wide shot at an archive desk in 2019, one generic researcher places a third blank investment folder beside two matching folders, the three separate folders centered, calm expression, mild window light

lines.text: 買方聯盟有黑石、加拿大退休金投資機構，以及樂高創辦家族的投資公司。

data.prompt: Medium close-up at a family-investment records desk in 2019, one generic archivist opens a plain portfolio binder beside a simple toy model and a park model, attentive expression, soft desk-lamp light

lines.text: 參與這筆交易的家族投資公司，叫柯克比，負責家族的持股與投資。
同一年的樂高年報把關係寫得很清楚：柯克比持有玩具公司四分之三股權；

data.prompt: Medium shot at a company-structure demonstration desk, one generic researcher sets a park model into a separate tray beside a tray holding toy bricks, focused expression, soft overhead light

lines.text: 梅林則是柯克比的關聯公司。
於是，家族可以同時投資積木公司和樂園經營者。

data.prompt: Close-up at the same demonstration desk, one generic researcher places a small divider between the toy tray and the park tray, thoughtful face visible, mild window light

lines.text: 這筆交易沒有把兩家公司合成同一家公司。

data.prompt: Medium close-up in a 2019 archive study, one generic archivist places a blank nameplate beside a closed rights folder, a small park model farther back, attentive expression, soft lamp light

lines.text: 樂高及樂園的商標由柯克比持有；品牌、投資和園區經營，分別有自己的安排。

data.prompt: Wide shot at a demonstration table, one generic adult presenter arranges a toy tray, an investment binder and a park model in three separate spaces, calm expression, soft grey window light

lines.text: 同一個品牌背後，玩具公司、投資公司和樂園經營者，各自有自己的位置。

data.prompt: Medium shot at the familiar ledger desk, one generic researcher draws the bookmarked financial ledger back toward the center, expectant expression, other folders rest off to the side, mild table-lamp light

lines.text: 股權的故事走到了這裡；開頭翻開的那份二〇〇五年帳本，

data.prompt: Close-up at the ledger desk, one generic researcher opens the bookmarked page with a single finger, intent face above the blank page, soft lamp light from the left

lines.text: 還等著把轉盈的來源說完整。

data.prompt: Medium shot at a quiet study desk, one generic adult reader holds a small park model above an open empty tray beside toy bricks, thoughtful expression toward the viewer, gentle table-lamp light

lines.text: 如果要換取重整的時間，你願意賣掉一門還能賺錢的生意嗎？

data.prompt: Wide shot at the same study desk, one generic adult reader closes the familiar ledger beside the park model and toy bricks, relaxed expression, the desk remains spacious for the later transition, soft neutral lamp light

lines.text: 喜歡從真實紀錄聽懂品牌的決定，歡迎訂閱。
